parameters.query:
with params as (
  select $1::vector(1536) as v,
         nullif($2, '')::vector(1536) as cv,
         coalesce(nullif($3, ''), '{}')::jsonb as filter,
         websearch_to_tsquery('romanian', $4) as q
),
alone as (
  select id, row_number() over (order by dist, id) as rk
  from (select d.id, d.embedding <=> p.v as dist
        from documents d, params p
        where p.filter = '{}'::jsonb or d.metadata @> p.filter
        order by d.embedding <=> p.v, d.id
        limit 50) s
),
with_context as (
  select id, row_number() over (order by dist, id) as rk
  from (select d.id, d.embedding <=> p.cv as dist
        from documents d, params p
        where p.cv is not null and (p.filter = '{}'::jsonb or d.metadata @> p.filter)
        order by d.embedding <=> p.cv, d.id
        limit 50) s
),
keyword as (
  select id, row_number() over (order by score desc, id) as rk
  from (select d.id, ts_rank(to_tsvector('romanian', translate(d.content, 'ăâîșşțţĂÂÎȘŞȚŢ', 'aaissttAAISSTT')), p.q) as score
        from documents d, params p
        where (p.filter = '{}'::jsonb or d.metadata @> p.filter)
          and to_tsvector('romanian', translate(d.content, 'ăâîșşțţĂÂÎȘŞȚŢ', 'aaissttAAISSTT')) @@ p.q
        order by score desc, d.id
        limit 50) s
),
fused as (
  select coalesce(a.id, c.id, w.id) as id,
         coalesce((case when p.cv is null then 0.9 else 0.63 end) / (50 + a.rk), 0)
         + coalesce(0.27 / (50 + c.rk), 0)
         + coalesce(0.1 / (50 + w.rk), 0) as score
  from alone a
  full outer join with_context c on c.id = a.id
  full outer join keyword w on w.id = coalesce(a.id, c.id)
  cross join params p
),
top as (
  select id, row_number() over (order by score desc, id) as pos
  from fused
  order by score desc, id
  limit 20
),
cutoff as (
  select max(0.7 * (d.embedding <=> p.v) + 0.3 * (d.embedding <=> coalesce(p.cv, p.v))) as worst
  from top t
  join documents d on d.id = t.id
  cross join params p
),
shared as (
  select id, row_number() over (order by dist, id) as rk
  from (select d.id, 0.7 * (d.embedding <=> p.v) + 0.3 * (d.embedding <=> coalesce(p.cv, p.v)) as dist
        from documents d
        join kb_folders k on k.folder = d.metadata->>'folder' and k.kind = 'shared'
        cross join params p
        where p.filter = '{}'::jsonb
          and d.id not in (select id from top)
        order by dist, d.id
        limit 3) s
  where dist <= (select worst from cutoff) + 0.03
),
picked as (
  select id, pos from top where pos <= 20 - (select count(*) from shared)
  union all
  select id, 20 - (select count(*) from shared) + rk from shared
)
select d.id, d.content, d.metadata, pk.pos as rank
from picked pk
join documents d on d.id = pk.id
order by pk.pos
